evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Distinct search method (fingerprinting) not substantially contained in other search/recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Profile-based search is a different requirement from fingerprinting, similar-users search, or recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Similar-users based search is distinct from profile-based search and from recommendation stories (which are not explicitly search).

evaluations.evidence: discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Video-seeded content-similarity discovery is not the same requirement as generic music search or image-seeded video recommendation.

evaluations.evidence: discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Metadata/image-tag driven discovery is a distinct mechanism compared to fingerprinting, profiles, or similar-users.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Tag propagation across processing steps is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: UI requirement to view thumbnail sequences is not expressed in other stories.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Substantially overlaps with ZO-009, which also requests info about similar video items and segments; 'perceptually' does not create a meaningful distinct requirement here.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates ZO-008’s requirement to get info about similar video items/segments; difference is not clearly a distinct goal/permission/business rule.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Recommendation based on similar profiles is distinct from profile-based search (ZO-002) and from news-event recommendations (ZO-011).

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Location/news-event driven recommendations are not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Person identification is distinct from product/logo/brand identification stories.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Product identification is distinct from persons, logos, and brands.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Broadcaster-logo identification is distinct from products/brands/persons.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification is distinct from products and logos as stated.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Image-seeded video recommendation is not duplicated by other recommendation/search stories.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Map-based browsing/notification is distinct from other search/recommendation mechanisms.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is a distinct requirement not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Admin segmentation validation/editing is not duplicated by other admin annotation/filtering stories.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Topic extraction per segment is distinct from segmentation editing (ZO-019) and other filtering tasks.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: A/V quality ranking is distinct from nudity/copyright/asset-info prefiltering.

evaluations.evidence: quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Audio-edit detection is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Nudity prefiltering is distinct from other prefiltering criteria (low-level asset info, high-level metadata, copyright).

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level asset-information prefiltering is distinct from high-level metadata/tag prefiltering (ZO-026).

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright validation is a distinct pre-ingestion/ingestion check not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter ... using search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tag prefiltering is distinct from low-level asset-info prefiltering (ZO-024).

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is
evaluations.rationale: Image interestingness/appeal assessment is not duplicated by other Zooniverse-admin automation stories.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject
evaluations.rationale: Scientist-prompt detection is distinct from volunteer interruption/education triggers.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer-type identification is distinct from weighting volunteer classifications (ZO-043) and interruption/education decisions.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Galaxy Zoo preclassification is distinct in dataset/context from other prefiltering/preclassification stories.

evaluations.evidence: detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Empty-animal detection is distinct from species/attribute/number preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection for ... timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images
evaluations.rationale: Series detection for timestamp malfunction is a distinct requirement from other Snapshot Serengeti classification tasks.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification is distinct from attribute preclassification (ZO-034) and number detection (ZO-035).

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification is distinct from species preclassification and number detection.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Number detection is distinct from species/attribute preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Plankton segmentation/localization is distinct from plankton empty-image detection and size/orientation/species detection.

evaluations.evidence: detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Empty-plankton detection is distinct from segmentation and species/size/orientation detection.

evaluations.evidence: automatic detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Size/orientation detection is distinct from species preclassification and segmentation/localization.

evaluations.evidence: automatic preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Plankton species preclassification is distinct from size/orientation detection and segmentation.

evaluations.evidence: automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Motion analysis for duration reduction is distinct from egg-laying time detection (ZO-041).

evaluations.evidence: detect the time ... where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Egg-laying event time detection is distinct from general motion analysis/duration reduction.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads
evaluations.rationale: Disaster-feature detection in satellite images is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer classification weighting is distinct from identifying volunteer types (ZO-029) and interruption/education decisions.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Artefact removal prefiltering is distinct from moving/transient object detection (ZO-045).

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is distinct from artefact removal (ZO-044).

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio denoising is distinct from whale-call grouping and whale counting.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Grouping similar whale calls is distinct from counting whales in an audio file (ZO-048).

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Whale counting is distinct from grouping similar calls (ZO-047).

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Timing decision for interruption is distinct from modality decision (ZO-050) and education decisions (ZO-051/052/053).

evaluations.evidence: whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Interruption modality selection is distinct from deciding when to interrupt (ZO-049).

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Timing decision for education is distinct from education modality/content selection (ZO-052/053).

evaluations.evidence: whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Education modality selection is distinct from deciding when to educate (ZO-051).

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Education content selection is distinct from education timing and modality decisions.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Detecting interesting volunteer comments is distinct from deciding when Zoonibot should comment/explain/say (ZO-055/056/057).

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Trigger for Zoonibot commenting is distinct from triggers for explanation (ZO-056) and content of what to say (ZO-057).

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Trigger for explanations is distinct from trigger for commenting (ZO-055) and from deciding message content (ZO-057).

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Message-content selection is distinct from deciding when to comment/explain (ZO-055/056).

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Subject similarity grouping is not duplicated elsewhere (distinct from whale-call grouping which is different domain/object).

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation to volunteers is distinct from content recommendations in earlier user stories (ZO-010/011/016) and from volunteer-type identification.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization for reuse is not expressed elsewhere in the backlog.
